1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that incorporates both contextual user input and system performance data__.

2. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and monitors user interactions to assess effectiveness.

3. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __, which also adapts visually based on user feedback__.

4. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification __while also allowing the user to input corrections__.

5. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by utilizing both real-time data and historical performance metrics__.

6. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __in a manner that reflects user proficiency level__.

7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification __, adapting to facilitate ease of understanding for the user__.

9. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface __, contextual actions shown, and the documented procedure__.

10. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images __along with user feedback__ to calculate the alignment.

11. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences __and learning progress within the documented procedure__.

12. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __considering user-specific adaptations__.

13. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device __that dynamically adjusts based on user input and performance analytics__; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images __and corresponding system feedback__ to calculate the alignment.

16. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __and adaptive learning metrics__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that integrates contextual user feedback and system performance__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and assessing user engagement to enhance accuracy.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __with adaptability to user interaction and comprehension levels__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and user proficiency__.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __with adjustments to support user needs__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface __, contextual actions demonstrated, and the documented procedure__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __and analysis of user interactions__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences __and application of adaptive learning theories__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __while accounting for user-specific contexts__.

27. (Currently Amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17 __, including adaptive learning components__.

28. (Currently Amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that elaborates on contextual user inputs__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment __that evolves according to user inputs__; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment __and user engagement feedback__.

30. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __and also incorporates feedback from user interactions__.

31. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __considering data from user interactions__.

32. (Currently Amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28 __, including adaptive learning systems__.
